name: 需求价格弹性系数计算

map.输入调价前后的价格与销量，采用弧弹性（中点法）计算需求价格弹性系数，评估收入变化: Enter price and quantity before and after a price change; arc elasticity (midpoint method) is used to compute the demand price elasticity coefficient, assess the revenue change and suggest a pricing strategy.
map.📖 查看「需求价格弹性系数计算 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Demand Price Elasticity Calculator User Guide"
map.弧弹性（中点法）：需求变化率=(q2−q1)/[(q1+q2)/2]，价格变化率: Arc elasticity (midpoint method): demand change rate = (q2−q1)/[(q1+q2)/2], price change rate = (p2−p1)/[(p1+p2)/2], Ed = demand change rate / price change rate (signed). |Ed|>1 is elastic and <1 inelastic; the revenue change rate = (p2×q2−p1×q1)/(p1×q1) shows which way a price change moves revenue.
map.💡 弧弹性 Ed =（ΔQ/Q̄）÷（ΔP/P̄），中点法避免方向偏误；|Ed|: 💡 Arc elasticity Ed = (ΔQ/Q̄) / (ΔP/P̄); the midpoint method avoids direction bias. |Ed|>1 elastic, <1 inelastic, =1 unit elastic.
map.采用弧弹性（中点法），适用于价格变动较大的场景: Uses arc elasticity (midpoint method), suitable for large price changes
map.弹性系数通常取绝对值判断，符号反映价格与需求反向关系: Elasticity is usually judged by absolute value; the sign reflects the inverse relation between price and demand
map.富有弹性时降价增收、涨价减收；缺乏弹性时反之: When demand is elastic, cutting price raises revenue and raising price lowers it; the reverse holds when demand is inelastic
map.短期弹性通常小于长期弹性，需结合时间维度判断: Short-run elasticity is usually smaller than long-run elasticity, so judge with the time dimension in mind
map.涨价前先估需求会掉多少，判断提价是否划算。: Estimate how far demand falls before a price increase to judge whether the increase pays off
map.促销降价时用弹性判断能多卖多少、总收入增还是减。: During a promotion, use elasticity to judge how much more sells and whether total revenue rises or falls
map.对比不同品类弹性，对刚需品可提价比弹性品更稳。: Compare elasticity across categories: price increases hold up better for necessities than for elastic goods
map.提价 10% 的需求变化: Demand change from a 10% price increase
map.价格由 100 涨到 110（+10%），销量由 1000 跌到 850（−15: Price rises from 100 to 110 (+10%) and quantity falls from 1000 to 850 (−15%), so elasticity E = −15%/+10% = −1.5; |E|>1 means elastic and the increase cuts total revenue from 100000 to 93500 CNY, so it does not pay off.
map.价格 +10%、销量仅 −3% → E=−0.3 缺乏弹性，总收入由 10000: Price +10% with quantity only −3% gives E = −0.3, inelastic; total revenue rises from 100000 to 113300 CNY, so a modest increase is appropriate.
map.|E|>1 富有弹性，价涨量跌更猛，总收入随提价下降；|E|<1 缺乏弹性，需求: |E|>1 means elastic: quantity falls faster than price rises, so total revenue drops when price rises. |E|<1 means inelastic: demand is rigid, so raising price raises revenue.
map.正常。价格与销量通常反向变动，弹性天然为负，看绝对值大小即可。: Yes. Price and quantity usually move in opposite directions, so elasticity is negative by nature; just look at the absolute value.
map.需求价格弹性系数计算工具，采用弧弹性（中点法）计算调价前后的弹性系数，判读富有弹: Demand price elasticity calculator: uses arc elasticity (midpoint method) to compute the coefficient before and after a price change, reads out elastic / inelastic / unit elastic, and quantifies the revenue change and pricing impact.
